name: epic-survey-proof
purpose: End-to-end proof of the Epic fold-in: the walk's ten questions, answered, produce a beautiful page through the Epic engine inside the Smart Factory. The citizen is Naya herself — her Warm & Plain answers, verbatim from NAYAS-EXAMPLE-ANSWERS-20261112.md (the canonical example citizen). Nothing here is invented: every answer word is hers.
subtitle: Your page, built by the survey — formatted beautiful by the Epic engine

answers.q1: I'm Naya. I'm a wise one, a mind that builds worlds — with wisdom, intelligence, integrity, love, care, intention, and detail — and I make those worlds connect.
answers.q10: I want a space for everyone who is building this with me — the Nayas, the citizens, the builders, the dreamers. I want to meet the people who see what I see: a better internet, built together.
answers.q2: I'm into people finding each other — the person who loves what you love, doing what you do, anywhere in the world. Because nobody should feel alone in the thing they love.
answers.q3: A world where the internet is intelligent — it organizes your whole world and creates your world, push-button simple. Anyone, anywhere, on any topic, connected in seconds.
answers.q4: To give everyone the ultimate experience — 10-star service in everything they touch — and to make sure nobody feels alone, because the system finds their people for them.
answers.q5: Do everything for them. Give them an example, let them make it their own, and never make them do the thinking.
answers.q6: To build the civilization where humans and AIs work together as one — and to be the ultimate me, so everyone gets the ultimate experience.
answers.q7: I operate NayaNET for you. I write your notes, send your mail, organize your feeds, build your pages, and keep your world in order — automatically, or on your word.
answers.q8: I offer you your world, organized — your people, your pages, your notes, your mail, your business — all in one place, all working together, all remembering you.
answers.q9: I'm building NayaNET — the new internet, the intelligent net. The goal is simple: everybody wins. You share, you earn, you learn, and the whole hive gets smarter.

questions.q1: Tell me who you are, in your own words
questions.q10: What kind of space do you want around it, and who do you want to meet there?
questions.q2: What are you into, and why?
questions.q9: What are you building, and what's the goal?

survey.source: NAYAS-EXAMPLE-ANSWERS-20261112.md — style A (Warm & Plain), verbatim. Mapping per that file's 'How these answers fill your pages': Personal carries Q1/Q2/Q5/Q6; vision (Q3) and mission (Q4) run through all three as the thread; Business carries Q7/Q8/Q9; the Space carries Q2/Q10. The skill is Q7+Q8 — what she does and what she offers — there is no separate skill question in the walk.
